title: Match Key Use
description: Purpose for which a declared match key resolves. Values name the existing protocol surfaces that consume the key. Retargeting is audience_include with a crm audience; it has no separate value.

enumDescriptions.audience_include: The seller matches this key against audiences synced through sync_audiences and referenced from targeting_overlay.audience_include, including crm audiences used for retargeting.
enumDescriptions.audience_exclude: The seller matches this key against audiences referenced from targeting_overlay.audience_exclude, including suppression audiences.
enumDescriptions.frequency_cap: The seller counts impressions against this key when it enforces a seller-side cap: a package frequency_cap, a MediaBuy frequency_cap, or a later seller-side grouping of buys. Seller-side caps never span sellers.
enumDescriptions.identity_match: For this product, the seller's TMP router forwards this key to buyer-side Identity Match, so the buyer's impression tracker can count the product's impressions against caps that span sellers. On a TMP provider declaration, the provider resolves this key in Identity Match.
enumDescriptions.conversion_attribution: The seller matches this key against conversion events sent through log_event for attribution.
